instruction: A candid studio photograph captures a medium full shot of two women dancing against a plain white wall. On the left, the woman with an afro in a brown button-up dress (R1) leans back dramatically, raising her right arm high while looking confidently at the camera. Behind her on the right, the woman with short brown hair in a striped shirt and white trousers (R2) also leans back, eyes closed with a joyful smile, her left hand resting near her head. Bright, soft studio lighting fills the frame, creating a clean, high-energy atmosphere.
elements: R1 leans back dramatically while raising her right arm high and looking confidently at the camera
R2 leans back behind R1 with eyes closed, a joyful smile, and her left hand resting near her head
R1 and R2 are both dancing in a candid studio photograph
R1 and R2 have distinct dance poses rather than mirrored identical poses
The dance takes place against a plain white wall with bright, soft studio lighting
